welcome.title: A tour of the image page
welcome.text: One gel image and what was done with it. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Read this gel
steps.text: New analysis starts a reading of the image: you draw or detect its lanes and bands, then measure them. An image may have several analyses. Edit changes its assay, gel type or description.

steps.title: The image itself
steps.text: The gel as it was uploaded, converted for display. The annotation editor of an analysis is where it can be zoomed and adjusted.

steps.title: Assay and details
steps.text: What the gel is read for, its gel type, the lanes drawn on it across its analyses, and the file's size. The description, when it has one, is under them.

steps.title: Its analyses
steps.text: Each with its status. Click one to open its results.
